mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, backup_record_id, event_type, status, detected_count, attempt_count, error_code, detected_at, confirmed_at, recovered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM file_integrity_event WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND event_type = 1 AND status IN (0, 1, 2, 4) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, file_id, backup_record_id, event_type, status, detected_count, attempt_count, error_code, detected_at, confirmed_at, recovered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM file_integrity_event WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND event_type = #{eventType} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT file_id FROM file_integrity_event WHERE event_type = 1 AND status IN (0, 1, 2, 4)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_integrity_event (file_id, backup_record_id, event_type, status, detected_count, attempt_count, error_code) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{backupRecordId}, #{eventType}, #{status}, #{detectedCount}, #{attemptCount}, #{errorCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE file_integrity_event SET backup_record_id = #{backupRecordId}, status = 2, detected_count = detected_count + 1, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE file_integrity_event SET backup_record_id = #{backupRecordId}, status = 2, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4
UPDATE file_integrity_event SET status = 3, error_code = NULL, recovered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
